title: awaiting a non-future is an error
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

failure.justification: The contract makes this an error without fixing the detection stage; static analysis may reject it, otherwise execution fails. The program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 18: the operand of await must be a Future<T> or an async void completion; awaiting a non-future is a static error.
